candidates.title: EM reference-masked (authored polygon mask)
candidates.description: Non-rectangular theatre mask shaped to the supplied Europe-Mediterranean reference. Whole-polygon inclusion by polygon∩mask overlap ratio. Iceland is a separate mask ring. Northern edge steps south-east to drop Murmansk/Arkhangelsk/deep northern Russia while keeping Baltic routes, Donbas eastern depth, Turkey, Caucasus edge, and Maghreb coastal belt.
candidates.notes: Mask authority. required_include covers Iceland city provinces plus Crimea/Kherson/Zaporizhzhia/Donetsk/Luhansk/Rostov anchors. explicit_exclude forces Murmansk (11370) and Arkhangelsk (11764) out. All 55 former threshold-band provinces have explicit freeze decisions in threshold_decisions_em_reference_masked_v1.json. No production authority until owner approval.

permission.notes: Permission wording is an owner assertion recorded for engineering gating. It is not a substitute for filing the underlying written instrument in-repo. Engineering must not overstate legal status beyond this assertion.

assumptions: Earth3 continent id is metadata only; crop uses authored mask/rect + whole-polygon rules.
Rectangular candidates remain for comparison only; mask candidate is the authored-theatre design under review.
Mask overlap ratio is area(province ∩ mask) / area(province); threshold default 0.35.
Provinces are never polygon-clipped; boundary spill keeps the complete Earth3 ring when included.
Iceland is a separate mask ring plus required-include IDs.
Murmansk and Arkhangelsk are explicit excludes on the masked candidate.
No production Earth3 subset is committed until owner approves a candidate.
AoH3 background tiles and scenarios are not imported.
Region coverage is validated via Earth3 city anchors, not political ownership.
No candidate is recommended as production authority in this revision package.
